name: Australian Conference of Economists 2027 (ACE 2027)
venue: RMIT, 124 La Trobe Street, Melbourne VIC 3000
conf_dates_note: Welcome Reception Tuesday evening; sessions Wednesday to Friday; Conference Dinner and ESA Awards Thursday night
expected_note: Dates, venue and a keynote are announced on the ESA event page, but no call yet. Estimated from ACE 2026's deadline (submissions closed 24 Apr 2026; notifications 8 May; presenter registration 29 May). ACE 2026 fees (AUD, GST incl.): non-members 800 early / 900 standard; members 675 / 755; students 350-500. ACE 2026 papers could go to an Economic Record special conference issue.
